Seasonal message for a patient start
Please take a moment
Travelers, please review companion animal rules before departure.
Companion Animal Travel Desk

Travelers should prepare documents, carriers, and calm handling for every companion animal journey. Our team checks safety concerns with care and gives clear guidance so each trip can proceed smoothly. <<FACT F062>> For reptile travel, <<FACT F060>> and staff will help you confirm the right arrangements before check-in.

Please keep your pet secure, follow crew directions, and allow extra space for gentle movement and rest. If your plans change, advise the desk as soon as possible so the record remains accurate and service stays dependable.

For personal support and final checks, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
